acceptance.reason: Schema completeness and stale-view safety do not prove useful drying advice or receipt on an installed closed app.

problem_evidence.situation: 641 declaration omits all three context fields despite the observed SYSTEM template; model output itself is incomplete. Location is not dropped after emission.
problem_evidence.memory: 641 baseline stops in model-selected ask_user then prepare before the150 correction. No context transport bug was proved; this patch is not a Memory semantic repair.
problem_evidence.presentation: Known failed reads may leave a cached action in the view; asynchronous hook freshness and owner isolation need direct regressions.

governance.omission_check: before SituationUpdate defaults for raw dict operation=create

existing_repair.instruction: Declare each missing key explicitly; grounded string or null, arrays empty when not established; do not invent a place or link.
existing_repair.qualification: CREATE declarations previously accepted with omissions can now invoke the existing repair; identical model-call counts are not promised.

focus_transport.existing_consumer: same-owner nodes already loaded for display

presentation.current_source: A supplied star uses only readError from its supplying map; a locally selected star uses only useTemporaryMemory.error.
presentation.unavailable: Stato non verificabile. Cached context is retained; the old imperative, estimate window and next-check/notification promises are not presented as current. An unavailable first read does not claim there are no Situations.
presentation.recovery: Only the current owner's latest successful read restores presentation. Older requests, previous refresh generations and unmounted/disabled scopes cannot publish or clear a newer error. A current empty map removes the previous star.
presentation.unchanged: Existing polling intervals, foreground triggers, cancellation API/owner checks, outcome expiry/revision checks, and conversation prose remain. No new historical receipt UI.
presentation.toast: receives null while the same local hook is in error
